G1-access.title: HYPOTHESIS: client X-Forwarded-For spoofing to evade per-IP bucket
G1-access.preconditions: rate limit enabled; no trustedProxies/ipAddressHeaders configured in lib/auth.ts
steps: Send >3 sign-in attempts within 10s, each with a distinct spoofed X-Forwarded-For header (e.g. 1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.2, …)
Observe whether the limit resets per spoofed IP
G1-access.expected: LIKELY BYPASS. getIp default header is x-forwarded-for; with no trustedProxies set, a single-value XFF is trusted verbatim (getIPFromHeader: length===1 path). Each distinct spoofed IP = distinct bucket key ip|path → attacker resets the 3/10s counter at will. Because next start also sets XFF from socket.remoteAddress via ??= (only when absent), a client-supplied XFF wins. Config has no advanced.ipAddress.* → no mitigation. Flag as P0 security finding to confirm.
G1-access.source: @better-auth/core/dist/utils/ip.mjs:172-217 (getIp/getIPFromHeader, DEFAULT_IP_HEADERS=['x-forwarded-for'], trustedProxies default empty); apps/web/node_modules/next/dist/server/base-server.js:577 (x-forwarded-for ??= remoteAddress); apps/web/src/lib/auth.ts (no advanced.ipAddress config)

G1-access.title: HYPOTHESIS: all users collapse into one bucket behind Cloudflare Tunnel
